snippet.title: Forefront 1.0: Full Release | Launch Trailer 💥
snippet.description:
It's finally here. Farewell, Early Access. Welcome, to Forefront 1.0! AVAILABLE NOW!

Not only can you conquer the new Clearwater map and visit the Training Grounds, you will also get to take your shot with a Combat Bow, test out the new drone, rock a field perk of your choice, let that dynamic light shine on PC, and much, MUCH more.

---

Get it NOW:
➡️ Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/experiences/forefront/28816918137899319/ 
➡️ SteamVR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981220/Forefront 
➡️ Pico: https://store-global.picoxr.com/gb/detail/1/7478245947567292421

Wishlist for PS VR2:
➡️ https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018044

---

From the creators of Breachers and Hyper Dash comes an all-out war experience like never before in VR. Engage in massive 32-player battles across a variety of expansive semi-destructive environments, where strategy, skill and teamwork decide the outcome.

In the war between O.R.E. and the local armies and governments, you are the tip of the spear — which side will you take?
